info.title: Fizzlayer API
info.summary: Send sensor readings to Fizzlayer and connect AI agents to them.
info.description: Fizzlayer is the secure connection layer for AI agents. This document is the sensors API that works today: devices post readings with a per-sensor API key, and AI agents read sensors, readings, and alerts through the remote MCP server with an agent token. The hosted gateway is in private beta and is not part of this API. Account management uses the website or its WebMCP tools. Guide: https://fizzlayer.com/sensors/docs

tags.description: Threshold and silence alerts for the signed-in account. Phone calls stay on paid plans. Email and webhook are included on every plan until the owner gates them.

post.summary: Send readings for one sensor, or a batch from Home Assistant
post.description: Stores 1 to 16 metrics observed at one moment. Metrics are validated against the sensor's type (for example, a Temperature sensor accepts temperature_c from -100 to 200); Custom sensors accept any metric name. Sending the same event_id again is idempotent, so retries are safe. A Home Assistant connection key may instead send {"readings": [ ... ]} with 1 to 40 of those objects. One bad item does not reject the rest. Limits: 1,200 readings a minute per sensor and 5,000 per account.

202.description: Readings stored (or already stored under this event_id).

415.description: The body is not sent as application/json.

get.description: Discover live addresses here instead of hardcoding a host. Returns enabled:false until FIZZ_STREAM_URL is set. The hosted service uses the /compute/v1/fizz-worker prefix (not /workers/v1/) and mqtt_tcp_url null: MQTT is WebSocket only (subprotocol mqtt), with no TCP port 1883. Device sockets and MQTT publish use the sensor API key. Viewer sockets use a 15-minute token from POST /api/stream.

200.description: Streaming is off, or the public worker URLs.

post.description: Session cookie or Authorization: Bearer fizz_agent_.... The token lasts 15 minutes, is scoped to the workspace, and cannot publish. Optional sensor_id limits it to one owned sensor. 60 an hour per workspace, 30 an hour per agent.

201.description: Token minted once. It is not stored in a recoverable form.

404.description: sensor_id is not in this workspace.

post.summary: Create a threshold or silence alert
post.description: Requires the signed-in dashboard session. channels lists dashboard, phone, email, and webhook. Omit it for a dashboard alert, or send notify_channel "call" with notify_phone for the existing phone behavior (dashboard plus that call). Phone calls require a paired US number and Tinkerer, Pro, or Enterprise. Email is sent only to the account's verified address and is refused unless RESEND_API_KEY and FIZZ_ALERT_FROM are set. webhook_url must be public https. An optional webhook_secret (16 to 128 characters) signs that alert; otherwise the account secret does. Repeating an identical alert returns the existing rule.

200.description: The alert rule, with created true or false when an identical rule was already active.

402.description: Phone calls, or email and webhook when the owner has gated them, are not included on this plan.

404.description: The sensor is not in this account.

patch.summary: Pause, resume, or change how an alert notifies
patch.description: Requires the signed-in dashboard session. Send enabled to pause or resume, which is what the dashboard does today. Also send channels to replace dashboard, phone, email, and webhook. Phone, email, and webhook follow the same rules as create. Omit channels to leave them unchanged.

402.description: The selected channels are not included on this plan.

404.description: The alert is not in this account.

post.description: A stateless MCP server. Tools: list_sensors, get_readings, list_alerts, create_alert (threshold or silence alerts; tokens allowed to create alerts), and pair_device. create_alert accepts channels of dashboard, phone, email, and webhook. Phone calls require a number the owner has already paired and a plan that includes calls (Tinkerer, Pro, or Enterprise). Email uses the account's verified address. webhook_url must be a public https URL, and the JSON body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in X-Fizzlayer-Signature. Agent tokens cannot pair a phone number. No initialize call or session is required. Supports protocol versions 2026-07-28 (send the version in _meta with MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, and Mcp-Name headers) and 2025-03-26 through 2025-11-25. Limit: 120 requests a minute per token. Requests carrying another website's Origin header are rejected. Server card: https://fizzlayer.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

200.description: A JSON-RPC response with a result or a JSON-RPC error.

202.description: A notification was accepted. No body.

401.description: Missing, revoked, or invalid agent token.

403.description: The request came from another website's page.

429.description: More than 120 requests a minute for this token.

200.description: Whether the service, its database, and the alert scheduler are working. The scheduler is healthy when its last successful run was under five minutes ago. recent lists up to eight of those runs, newest first. This is not an uptime history.

example.description: The secure connection layer for AI agents

post.description: Stores a row in fizz_business_interest. Enterprise uses it for a sales inquiry. The homepage private-beta form uses it with interest set to "Gateway private beta". The row is not emailed. A post with no company is the retired waitlist and is rejected. Limited per network to stop abuse.

410.description: The request has no company. The waitlist this endpoint used to accept is closed (code waitlist_closed); create an account in the app instead.

sensorKey.description: A sensor API key (fizz_ followed by 64 hex characters), shown once when a real API sensor is created or its key is rotated on https://fizzlayer.com/sensors. Each key works for one sensor.

agentToken.description: An agent token (fizz_agent_...), created on https://fizzlayer.com/sensors/agents or with the create_agent_connection WebMCP tool. Revocable at any time.

sensor_id.description: The sensor this key belongs to.

event_id.description: Your unique ID for this sample. Resending it is ignored.

observed_at.description: When the reading was taken. Defaults to the time it is received.

metrics.description: Metric names and values. Built-in types: water flow_l_min (0-200) and leak; gas concentration_ppm (0-10000) and alarm; radio rssi_dbm (-150-0); temperature temperature_c (-100-200); pressure pressure_kpa (0-1000); humidity humidity_pct (0-100); sound sound_db (0-160); phone acceleration_ms2 (0-300) and orientation_deg (-360-360). Custom sensors accept any metric.

notify_channel.description: Legacy choice. none is dashboard. call is dashboard plus notify_phone. Ignored when channels is set, except that call without the phone channel is rejected.

notify_phone.description: US number, required when phone is selected.

InvalidRequest.description: A field is missing or a value doesn't fit.

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, wrong, rotated, or revoked.

TooLarge.description: The body is larger than 16 KB.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait and retry.
